title: Continual Learning for 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis via Experience and Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2610.01301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most current grasp synthesis systems are trained offline and remain fixed during deployment. While this works well when deployment conditions resemble the training data, performance can degrade when robots encounter conditions they have not seen before, such as unfamiliar objects. In this work, we present a continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis for a parallel-jaw gripper in cluttered scenes. Rather than finetuning a large parametric model, our method adapts through memory in a learned embedding space: grasp outcomes update future grasp scores, while optional user demonstrations are recalled and transferred to new scenes as additional candidate grasps. We evaluate our method in simulation and in extensive real-world experiments comprising over 1500 grasp trials. translated_title: 基于经验与演示的6自由度抓取合成持续学习
translated_abstract: 大多数现有的抓取合成系统都是离线训练的，并且在部署阶段保持固定不变。当部署条件与训练数据相似时，这种方式效果良好；但当机器人遇到此前未见过的情况（例如不熟悉的物体）时，性能可能会下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种面向杂乱场景中平行夹爪单视角6自由度抓取合成的持续学习框架。我们的方法不是对大型参数模型进行微调，而是通过学习到的嵌入空间中的记忆来实现自适应：抓取结果会更新未来的抓取评分，同时可选的用户演示会被召回并作为额外的候选抓取迁移到新场景中。我们在仿真环境以及包含超过1500次抓取试验的大量真实世界实验中对所提方法进行了评估。结果表明，即使在自适应之前，我们的方法也能达到现有6自由度抓取基线的性能水平，并在面对未见过的物体时实现在线性能提升。
tldr: 提出了一种通过嵌入空间记忆和可选用户演示实现在线自适应的持续学习框架，使平行夹爪在杂乱场景中的单视角6自由度抓取合成无需微调大型模型即可媲美现有基线，并能在面对未见物体时持续在线提升性能。
en_tdlr: A continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis that adapts online through memory in a learned embedding space and optional user demonstrations, matching existing baselines without finetuning large parametric models while continuously improving on unseen objects.
